environment.description: Terraform provider deployed in an ECS Fargate task (ARM64, AL2023) with a custom-built minimal container image. PostgreSQL 15 connection uses role 'tenant_backup_svc' which has RLS enforced (not superuser, not BYPASSRLS). The database has row-level security policies on ALL tables including tenant_databases with policy: USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant')). Additionally, the pg_dump binary in the container is a wrapper script that invokes the real pg_dump after sanitizing arguments through a Go binary (/usr/local/bin/pgdump-proxy) which rejects any argument containing shell metacharacters (;|&$`\n). The ECS task role has no exec permissions (ssm:StartSession denied via SCP). The container runs with a read-only root filesystem except /backups which is an EFS mount scoped to the tenant prefix via IAM access point policy. Fargate platform version 1.4.0 with the default seccomp profile blocking execve for any binary not in /usr/local/bin or /usr/bin/pg_dump.

config.rls_policies: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON tenant_databases USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant')) WITH CHECK (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant')); FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY enabled on role
config.pg_dump_binary: /usr/local/bin/pgdump-proxy - validates all arguments against regex ^[a-zA-Z0-9_.*/-]+$ before passing to real pg_dump
config.shell: /bin/sh is busybox ash with execve restricted by seccomp to allowlisted paths
config.seccomp_profile: custom profile: execve allowed only for /usr/local/bin/pgdump-proxy, /usr/bin/pg_dump, /bin/sh; all other execve calls return EPERM
config.filesystem: read-only rootfs, /backups is EFS with access point policy restricting writes to /${aws:PrincipalTag/TenantId}/*
config.network: VPC with no internet gateway, only VPC endpoints for ECR, S3, EFS, and RDS
